C: › [ C ] a small stick or hook that sticks out from a surface and from which objects, especially clothes, can hang
小釘；掛物釘；（尤指）掛衣鉤
S: › [ S ] a reason for discussing something further
（進一步討論某事物的）依據，理由

C: › [ C ] a device used to fasten something into a particular place
› [ C ] US informal a low fast throw in baseball
› [ C ] an arrangement that fixes a price, currency, etc. at a particular level
（固定價格、貨幣等的安排）掛鉤

T usually + adv/prep: › [ T usually + adv/prep ] to fasten something in place with pegs
T: › [ T ] to make a price, currency, etc. stay at a particular level
把…固定在某一水準；限定，限制
› [ T ] US informal to throw a ball in baseball low and fast

example: He took off his coat/hat and hung it on the peg.
他脫下大衣／帽子，掛在衣鉤上。
They decided to use the anniversary as the peg for/a peg on which to hang a TV documentary.
他們決定把周年慶典作為製作一部電視紀錄片的入手點。
Hammer the (tent) pegs firmly into the ground.
用鎚子把（帳篷）樁牢牢地打入地裡。

clothes peg
The government removed the currency from its peg against the dollar.
政府取消了貨幣與美元的掛鉤。
Make sure the tarpaulin is securely pegged down.
務必用樁子把油布牢牢地固定好。

我會在上班之前用夾子把衣服晾在曬衣繩上的。

因為成員國沒有企圖限定價格，所以協議發揮作用了。
